decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at C564-14 (radio and CMMS agree, likely repair 13:20). The stope holds 138 t at 12.1 g/t, about 53.7 oz. LH-09 comes from DS-C564-02, which is 0.34 h away and is the cheaper nearby development heading at 1.5 oz/h. At 29.1 t/h it clears the stope in about 4.7 h, so the dev cost is about 7-8 oz. Central has truck headroom: 91 t/h capacity against 78 t/h inflow, and the stockpile is 171 of 450 t. LH-08 is 0.71 h away, which is farther. The other stopes are producing, so I'm not moving them. Net is about +40 oz.
